title: DUALZ—Deep UNCOVER-ALMA Legacy High-Z Survey
question: Establish a joint ALMA and JWST legacy field in Abell 2744 and, through a blind 1.2-mm survey with NIRCam/NIRSpec counterparts, characterize the faint dust continuum sources, HST-/JWST-dark galaxies, a z=6.33 [CII] emitter, z>9 galaxies, and the infrared luminosity function

what.value: Lens mass model of A2744 for magnifications

evidence.quote: using the lens model presented in (cite: furtak2023a)

what.value: NIRCam DR2 source catalog and photometry

evidence.quote: cross-match our ALMA continuum source catalog with the DR2 NIRCam source catalog presented in (cite: weaver2023)

what.value: SED-fit physical parameter catalog (Prospector) and photo-z

evidence.quote: physical parameter catalog constrained with all available *HST* and *JWST* data in A2744 and the ALMA photometry obtained from the DUALZ survey (cite: bwang2024)
spectroscopic redshift ($z_{\rm spec}$) compilation in A2744 from the literature (cite: fujimoto2023b)

recipe.method: tclean on pipeline-calibrated visibilities, natural and uv-tapered, Wide and Deep (concat with ALMA-HFF/ALCS)
key_parameters: pixel 0.1 arcsec, natural weighting, taper 1.5 arcsec, automask

recipe.goal: Blind source extraction with purity estimate
recipe.method: sextractor positive peaks above 2 sigma; negative-peak analysis on inverted maps; SNR thresholds chosen where positives exceed negatives
key_parameters: Deep thresholds 4.8 (natural), 4.2 (tapered); regions down to 20% relative sensitivity

recipe.method: Peak pixel, 1.0'' aperture, or imfit Gaussian; imfit adopted if SNR>10 else best SNR; PB correction afterwards
Cross-match with NIRCam DR2 catalog within 1.0'' radius, nearest taken; chance projection probability estimated
Prospector-beta SED fitting (dynesty, parrot) and EAZY; use zspec if available, else zphot; EAZY adopted if estimates differ by >1.0; magnification from Furtak lens model
assumptions: AID20 assumed z=2.0; AID60 assumed z=9.0

recipe.goal: Search for [CII] emitter with NIRCam priors
recipe.method: Extract beam-aperture ALMA spectra at positions of 150 NIRCam galaxies (F150W<27.5, zphot=6-7); detect line, derive z, L_CII, L_IR
assumptions: Modified blackbody Td=45 K, beta=1.8 for L_IR; FWHM=200 km/s and 5 sigma for LF

recipe.goal: Search for dust at z>9 and stack
recipe.method: Inspect Wide-natural cutouts for 16 z>=9 galaxies; stack maps; chance probability from marginal-source density
IRLF at z=1-5 and z=8-11 following ALCS method; modified blackbody Td=35 K, beta=1.8; Gehrels Poisson errors; no completeness correction

evidence.quote: we identify 65 ALMA sources from the *Wide* maps and an additional 4 ALMA sources from the deep maps
median values of $z=2.30$, $\mu=1.7$, and $S_{\rm 1.2mm}^{\rm int}=0.24$ mJy
we identify 67 ALMA sources with NIRCam counterparts
This yields 27 sources whose redshifts have been spectroscopically determined.
We identify eight ALMA sources (AID2, AID3, AID5, AID10, AID27, AID31, AID48, and AID52)
The line feature is detected at $259.445\pm 0.015$ GHz with the line width of $220\pm40$ km s$^{-1}$
resulting in the \[C ii\]-based redshift estimate of $z=6.3254\pm0.0004$
we infer the lower limit of $3.2\times10^{-5}$ Mpc$^{-3}$

answer_key.quantity: Stacked intrinsic 1.2-mm flux of z>~9 galaxies

evidence.quote: inferring an intrinsic (lens-corrected) 1.2-mm flux density of $14.0\pm6.2$ $\mu$Jy
